# L2 — Container Diagram: Agentic Orchestrator

The system has no long-running services. Each stage invocation is a short-lived Podman
container running Claude Code CLI. The host runs `loop.sh` which spawns one container
at a time, sequentially.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    classDef person fill:#08427b,color:#fff,stroke:#073b6f
    classDef container fill:#438dd5,color:#fff,stroke:#3c7ebc
    classDef store fill:#438dd5,color:#fff,stroke:#3c7ebc,stroke-dasharray: 5 5
    classDef external fill:#999,color:#fff,stroke:#8a8a8a

    dev["Developer"]:::person

    subgraph host["Host - Developer Workstation"]
        loop["loop.sh<br/><i>Bash</i><br/><i>Reads orchestrator.yaml,<br/>spawns one sandbox per stage,<br/>exits on APPROVED/FAILED/BLOCKED</i>"]:::container
        sandbox["run-claude-sandbox.sh<br/><i>Bash</i><br/><i>Builds image, resolves .env,<br/>volumes, network, hardening flags</i>"]:::container
        validate["validate-loop-prereqs.sh<br/><i>Bash</i><br/><i>Checks task infrastructure exists</i>"]:::container
        worktree[("Project Worktree<br/><i>Source code, task specs,<br/>personas, feedback,<br/>TASK_LIST.md cursor</i>")]:::store
        auth[("~/.claude-sandbox/auth<br/><i>Claude Code auth tokens</i>")]:::store
        config["orchestrator.yaml<br/><i>YAML config</i><br/><i>Workflow mode, models,<br/>quality gates</i>"]:::store
    end

    subgraph container_box["Podman Container - per stage"]
        claude_cli["Claude Code CLI<br/><i>Node.js</i><br/><i>--dangerously-skip-permissions<br/>-p task, --model per stage</i>"]:::container
    end

    anthropic["Anthropic API"]:::external
    podman["Podman Runtime"]:::external

    dev -->|"./loop.sh"| loop
    loop -->|"--task-file<br/>--model per stage"| sandbox
    sandbox -->|"podman run"| podman
    podman --> claude_cli
    claude_cli -->|"API calls"| anthropic
    claude_cli -->|"Reads specs/personas,<br/>writes code/feedback,<br/>updates cursor"| worktree
    sandbox -->|"Mounts"| auth
    loop -->|"Reads BUILD_STATUS.md<br/>and TASK_LIST.md<br/>between stages"| worktree
    loop -->|"Reads model routing"| config
```

## Concurrency Model

Strictly sequential. `loop.sh` runs one `podman run` at a time, waits for it to exit,
reads filesystem state, then decides whether to run the next stage. No parallelism
within the loop. The `</dev/null` redirect on line 73 of `loop.sh` prevents Claude Code
from reading stdin.

## State Management

All state is filesystem-based:
- `tasks/TASK_LIST.md` — cursor position (`→ NEXT:`), checkbox state, attempt counters
- `tasks/BUILD_STATUS.md` — single word: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, or `FAILED ...`
- `tasks/feedback/` — judge verdicts, review output, verify logs
- `tasks/FEEDBACK.md` — accumulated feedback across all iterations

The loop reads `BUILD_STATUS.md` and `TASK_LIST.md` after each container exits to
determine the next action. There is no in-memory state between stages.
